concept.title: Set Up Entities for Caps and Floors
concept.shortdesc: This topic describes how to configure entity-level settings for cap and floor processing, including netting options.

conbody.p: defines one field at the entity level specific to caps and floors. You must specify the Net Cap Floor field value before trading cap or floor contracts. If you do not specify this value, trades fail to process and tools such as the Book Trade tool do not display the correct trading options.

section.title: Treating the Cap or Floor as Two Separate Positions
section.p: If you set the entity's Net Cap Floor field to No, an entity can maintain both a long and a short position in the same cap or floor security master record. stores separate long and short positions. Each position represents either a long intent or a short intent. The system does not net longs and shorts into one position. The Tech Short Eligible Indicator field (tag 57) determines whether the position can go technically short.

section.title: Netting the Cap or Floor to a Single Position
section.p: If you set the entity's Net Cap Floor field to Yes, stores one net cap or floor position. An entity can be either net long or net short in the same cap or floor security master record. The system nets longs and shorts into one position. If you set the Net Cap Floor field to Yes, the system always allows a cap or floor position to go technically short, overriding the entity's Tech Short Eligible Indicator field setting.
